The whole-tumour mass is predominantly right-sided (confidence 0.99).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.98).

The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is mid (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.58). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is substantially outside the training cohort range (mean |z| = 1.11); this case is a known weak point of the system.
